_comment: 'The WINNER creates a Might token' was authored as on_win (CLASH reads on_winner) holding a nested {'type':'CREATE_TOKEN'} where CLASH expects an outcome spec {'action':'create_token','who':...}. Two mismatches on one node, so the token was never created at all -- unlike its five siblings, which created it unconditionally. The unread 'target' filter read ATTACK_CLASS_IN classes=['hero'], and 'hero' is not a class.
